contract.close_uncertainty: External close is attempted at most once only from known HeldUnvalidated; an actual returned failure remains UnknownAfterCloseReturn and refuses the case. Entered without return cannot reach downstream report. No retry, probe, dup, token reuse or native operation through any unknown or possibly closed token. An omitted-close control leaves known held custody until child termination without acknowledging cleanup.
contract.expected_diagnostic: Only OF_INFRA_FILE_VALIDATION together with the exact explicit evaluated/raw-valid/authored-veto/consumed-false tuple and an independently valid raw receipt is expected. Actual failed query, identity mismatch, missing receipt, setup/capacity/argument/phase/report/observer/cleanup error is refused. No blanket infrastructure-success reinterpretation.

contract.intent: Exercise known HeldUnvalidated custody after an explicit consumed-validation veto following genuine successful open and identity queries. Do not seek actual close failure or missing returns.
contract.limitations: No durability, signal safety, native visibility, callback quiescence, arbitrary loader/interposition, recovery or fault-causation proof. LL/SC retry and libc/canary/sanitizer dependencies remain. Quarantine/startup protections and all live gates remain unchanged.
contract.native_policy: Open uses the existing exclusive nofollow fixed-name flags and0600. Native raw/error capture remains immediate in unchanged leaves. Native success error_valid=false/error_number0 is preserved despite explicit errno instrumentation. fd0 remains representable but is not a forced selector; descriptor number must be observed, never guessed.
contract.ownership: One same-Linux parent supervisor owns a fresh0700 disposable directory and fixed witness.dat name for one fresh exec child. Inherited directory/report descriptors remain distinct from the child's newly opened native int fd. No external writer, descriptor alias, close/reuse or callback retained pointer is permitted within the authored fixture.
contract.raw_identity: Raw identity availability is an ordinary serial evidence-validity marker, never a second attempt admission or publication/race contract. It is write-once after full successful-query validation and never changed by controls or cleanup.
